allOf.description: A layout component that arranges its children horizontally. To create a grid layout, nest Columns within this Row.

children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

justify.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges, or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together. Values: `start` packs children at the left/start edge; `center` centers children horizontally; `end` packs children at the right/end edge; `spaceBetween` distributes extra space between children and pushes the first and last child to the edges; `spaceAround` places equal space around each child; `spaceEvenly` places equal space between children and at both edges.

align.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (vertically). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property, but uses camelCase values (e.g., 'start'). Values: `start` aligns children to the top; `center` centers children vertically; `end` aligns children to the bottom.
